matter_background.original: Amara Perera of No. 3, Old Road, Pannipitiya wishes to retain you as his Notary for the purpose of purchasing a shop bearing Assessment No. 2, Galle Road, Kollupitiya for a sum of Rupees Thirty Million (Rs.30,000,000/=) from Aruna Silva of No.2, Nawala Road, Nawala who held and possessed the said shop premises by virtue of Deed of Transfer No.27 dated 27/05/1994 attested by A. Silva Notary Public of Colombo.
